# Burnworth Co.

> Founder-led web development, SEO and AI search visibility for service businesses.
> Run by Brandon and Zenande Burnworth. Every engagement is delivered by the people who plan it.

## Services

- [Web Development, SEO & AI Visibility](https://burnworthco.com/services): Web development, SEO, GEO and AI visibility services for businesses that need a fast website and a clear plan to get found.
- [Web Development Services](https://burnworthco.com/web-development): Custom web development for service businesses. Get a fast, mobile-ready website with clear content, technical SEO, analytics, and launch support.
- [Local SEO for Contractors & Service Firms](https://burnworthco.com/local-seo): Local SEO for contractors and service businesses: clear service pages, accurate business profiles, project evidence and qualified-lead measurement.
- [SEO & AI Visibility Audit](https://burnworthco.com/search-visibility-audit): Find crawl problems, missing service content and gaps in Google and AI visibility. Get a prioritized action plan tied to qualified inquiries.
- [What Is Generative Engine Optimization?](https://burnworthco.com/generative-engine-optimization): A practical, evidence-led explanation of generative engine optimization and how GEO works with SEO to improve visibility in AI answers.

## Research and writing

- [State of Search 2026](https://burnworthco.com/research): A sourced briefing on AI search adoption, zero-click behavior, citations, measurement, and the 2027 visibility strategy.

## Work

- [Website & Search Projects](https://burnworthco.com/work): Explore Burnworth Co. client projects in flooring and broadcast equipment rental, and the business questions behind the website and search work.
- [Top Tier Custom Floors Project](https://burnworthco.com/work-top-tier-custom-floors): Website and local-search project context for Top Tier Custom Floors, a Valley Center flooring business serving San Diego County.
- [LA Production Company Website](https://burnworthco.com/work-los-angeles-production-company): Website project context for a Los Angeles-based production company providing robotic camera and motion systems for production.
